prompt: Create an original 60 second acoustic jazz instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: piano, upright bass, brushed drums. Style: relaxed swing, walking bass and conversational piano. Tempo approximately 88 BPM; D major. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A gentle and melancholic orchestral piece featuring piano, strings, and flute. The melody is reflective and flowing, creating a serene atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首温柔而忧郁的管弦乐曲，以钢琴、弦乐和长笛为主。旋律富有沉思感且流畅，营造出宁静的氛围。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
